dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Linear; trailing edge follows a straight-line polygonal segment with zero curvature.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute; defined by a sharp vertex intersection of two linear edges.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45 degrees relative to the dorsal longitudinal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1:1 ratio between the fin base width and vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Angular; contour is composed of discrete flat polygonal faces rather than a continuous curve.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and blunt; length from inflection point is approximately 1.3 times the vertical thickness.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse angle of approximately 160 degrees at the vertex where the melon meets the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Low-polygon 3D mesh architecture with uniform cyan luminescence and faceted shading.
